reason: I'd grab the free sip on my way out of the subway, and since they name the grade and farm, I'd probably buy a plain matcha latte once or twice to compare it with Matchaful. But Matchaful is my place, and I'm not giving up my morning routine unless this is clearly better.
objection: Is the matcha actually as good as Matchaful's, or are the dessert-flavored drinks just covering up average matcha? Also, a café inside another shop might be slow when I'm rushing to the train.
would_change_my_mind: If the plain matcha tastes noticeably better than what I get now and they can have it ready in under three minutes, I'd switch for good and use the punch card.
